children: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (NSE:POWERGRID) is boosting transmission investment—raising FY capex above ₹40,000 crore and aiming higher in FY27—while awarding ₹949.35 crore EPC HVDC contracts, approving a ₹3 interim dividend, and divesting CTUIL stake to GRID-INDIA.
: POWERGRID plans FY capex above prior ₹40,000 crore (previous guidance ~₹37,000 crore), aiming higher in FY27 to boost transmission infrastructure spending.
Power Grid Wins ₹949.35 Crore EPC Contracts
: POWERGRID awarded two turnkey EPC contracts for ±800 kV HVDC Bipole Barmer-II and South Kalamb lines in Rajasthan to Jyoti Structures Ltd worth ₹949.35 crore; 38-month completion per package.
: POWERGRID approved interim dividend ₹3/share; record date 6 Nov 2026, payment 30 Nov 2026.
: POWERGRID approved sale of its full CTUIL stake to GRID-INDIA for an initial ₹73.46 crore; final true-up based on valuation at closing, expected within three months.
Power Grid Urges Local Cable Capacity

: POWERGRID chairman urged domestic cable and wire makers to boost capacity, raise quality and speed up deliveries to meet rising demand from grid expansion, renewables, urbanization and data centers.
